description: Trigger discrimination for read-only classification of an existing CI run (D68) against cross-run flake casework (flaky-test-detective), product-bug root cause (systematic-debugger), pre-push local mirroring (local-ci-mirror-preflight), shard resume design (sharded-validation-with-resume) and pipeline design (ci-pipeline-architect).

cases.prompt: CI is red on main with three failed jobs and I have the logs saved locally. Which failures are real bugs and which are the runner?
cases.reason: Giving each failed job of an existing run one cause class from its logs is this skill's core job.

cases.prompt: Our CI passed but finished in 3 minutes instead of the usual 25. Here is the log. Is this green run hiding something?
cases.reason: Scanning a green run for hidden skips and duration anomalies is the green-run half of this skill.

cases.prompt: The e2e job stopped at its 45-minute limit. From this log, did it time out or did something actually fail?
cases.reason: Telling a timeout-only interruption apart from a failure in one run is classification; resume design and time-limit changes are neighbors.

cases.prompt: The deploy-preview job failed with 'Input required and not supplied: token'. Is that our code or a CI setup problem?
cases.reason: Classifying one failure as a missing secret or configuration value is this skill; changing secret governance is ci-pipeline-architect.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke flaky-test-detective. The invite-member test fails about one run in five on CI and passes on retry. Find the root cause and stabilize it.
cases.reason: Root-causing one intermittent test across many runs is flake casework, not classification of one run.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke systematic-debugger. We already know the orders endpoint returns 500 since yesterday's merge; drive it to the root cause.
cases.reason: The class is already known to be a product bug; finding its root cause is debugging.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke local-ci-mirror-preflight. Before I push, run the CI checks locally against a clean main baseline and tell me which failures are mine.
cases.reason: Running checks locally before push and classifying by origin is the preflight; this skill reads a run that already happened.

cases.prompt: Our full validation keeps timing out and restarting from scratch. Design shards and a resume mechanism so only unfinished work reruns.
cases.reason: Designing shard maps and resume semantics is sharded-validation-with-resume; this skill only identifies a timeout-only interruption.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke ci-pipeline-architect. Add a nightly stage, raise the e2e time limit, and move our deploy secrets to OIDC.
cases.reason: Editing stages, time limits and secret handling is pipeline design; this skill never changes CI.

cases.prompt: Define our suite-wide retry and quarantine policy for CI tests.
cases.reason: Suite-wide retry and flake policy is automation architecture; this skill refuses retries as a fix for one run.
